cohort: 6652 women who gave birth during 2014 and 2015 at a hospital in a large city in Pakistan
finding: Oxytocin use during the first stage of labor was associated with an increased risk of emergency caesarean section for both primiparous and multiparous women.
mod_finding: Oxytocin use during the first stage of labor was associated with an increased risk of emergency C-section.
